接下来的几天，他饿了就以被吸入此地撞死的飞鸟为食，每日大部分时间都在仔细观察石珠，每次都是用上面出现的露水擦拭手臂，渐渐的手臂完全恢复如初，对于这露水，他极为在意，用一个飞鸟的头骨积累了不少。
这一日，他把多日积累的露水均匀的淋洒在一块衣服条上，珍重的把石珠包在其内，挂在脖子上拽了几下，确定不会掉落后，趁着吸力的间歇时间来到洞口，狠狠一咬牙，把身上大部分衣物都撕下，栓在一起，一边固定在旁位的石块，一边绑在腰上，小心翼翼的向下爬去。
大约下了有五六丈，忽然手中一滑，他的身体迅速下落，好在衣服略微吃力，他身子一荡，飞快抓在一颗横生出的枝干，此时衣服条从中间崩裂，拴在他腰上的那截晃晃悠悠的在半空中回荡。
王林额头冷汗冒出，向下一望，大约还有二十丈高，他一只手抓住树枝，另一只手迅速抓起衣服条，艰难的捆绑在树枝上，这才送了口气。
小心翼翼的挪动身体，许久之后终于再次临近悬崖壁，继续向下爬去。一直到距离崖底数丈时，他的衣服条已经用到极限，王林不假思索迅速向下一跳。
衣服条承受不住重量再次崩裂，不过也略微缓解了一下王林下落的速度，罡风扑面，又是一连串的枝干折断，在落地的一瞬间，他艰难的控制身体，脚尖首先着地，身子借着前冲的巨大推力包成一团在地上一滚。
地面的石头仿佛一把把尖刀，纷纷刺进他身子内，隔开一道道血粼粼的伤口。尤其是右腿更是被一根尖利的石块刺中，从伤口可见森森白骨。
王林呼吸急促，眼神涣散，他艰难从脖子上把包着石珠的布条含在嘴里，舌头吸允淋洒在上面的湿润露水，过了一会儿，他挣扎的坐起，双手颤抖的解开布条，对着右腿伤口使劲一拧，数滴液体落下。
伤口处传来阵阵凉意，做完这一切，他虚弱的倒在地上，暗自祈祷在自己恢复前不要有什么野兽过来。
就在这时，忽然从远处传来一阵呼喊声。
“铁柱，你在哪？”
王林一怔，仔细一听，这居然是他爹的声音，来不及思考，他立刻用全身力气喊道：“爹，我在这！”
一道长虹迅速从远处滑来，在王林上方的悬崖徘徊一圈后迅雷不及掩耳快速落下，剑光消散后，恒岳派张姓弟子腋下夹着铁柱他爹，皱着眉头望向王林。
铁柱他爹看到自己儿子，立即老泪纵横，跑到王林身边抱住他，哭道：“铁柱啊，你这是何苦，你怎么就想不开呢，你有没有想过你要是死了，爹娘该怎么活啊。”
王林一怔，略一琢磨，明白爹是误会自己要自杀，再一看身上的伤口以及狼狈的样子，不由得苦笑起来。
张姓弟子眼神一扫王林，抬头看了看上方，发现了衣服布条，身子一动跃起，几个起落间就攀岩到洞穴处，此时吸力突然出现，他面色一惊，但立刻就恢复如常，也不在意那吸力，在里面扫看一番轻轻落下，低沉道：“你家孩子是想自杀，结果被这天然形成的风眼吸扯，这才没有摔死，现在王林已经找到，等回到门派此事由长老定夺。”
说完，他袖子一卷，抓起王林父子二人，飞快离开此地，不大一会就来到恒岳派山峰下，顺着石阶轻而易举的登上顶端。
旧地重回，王林心情复杂，山顶上站立数人，均都面带厌恶之色，张姓弟子连忙上前在其中一人耳边说了几句，那人眉头紧皱，冷声道：“人既然找回来了，就送到客房与他母亲相见吧。”

在客房内，王林的母亲看到自己儿子，立刻泪流满面，抱住他呜咽埋怨，经过父母的口述，王林这才知道事情的原委。
他离家出走后，父母立刻回到王氏家族找到他四叔，三人担心他的安危，找到王卓的父亲，碍于他四叔的强硬，王卓父亲不情愿的联系家族所有亲戚，联名上访恒岳派，恳求帮助寻找。
恒岳派也是第一次遇到这种事情，本不想理会，可王林毕竟是因为没被收取而离家，若是真有个三长两短，他们虽说不在意一个凡人的生死，但这事若宣扬出去，周围所有村民口口言传，恐怕以后没有多少父母会让孩子来测试，考虑再三，他们派出几人在附近寻找，王林的父亲不放心，就跟了过去。

In the next few days, when he was hungry, he fed on the birds that were sucked and killed here. He spent most of the day carefully observing the stone beads, and every time he wiped his arms with the dew that appeared on them. Gradually, his arms completely recovered as before. He was extremely concerned about this dew, and accumulated a lot of it with the skull of a flying bird.
On this day, he evenly sprinkled the dew that had accumulated for many days on a piece of clothing, carefully wrapped the stone beads in it, hung it around his neck and pulled it a few times. After making sure that it would not fall, he took advantage of the interval of suction to come to the entrance of the cave, gritted his teeth, tore off most of his clothes, tied them together, fixed the stone on the side, tied it to his waist, and climbed down carefully.
He had fallen about five or six feet when his hand suddenly slipped and his body fell quickly. Fortunately, his clothes were a little strained. He swung and quickly grabbed a branch that grew out of the tree. At this time, the clothes strip burst from the middle, and the piece tied to his waist swayed in the air.
Cold sweat broke out on Wang Lin's forehead. He looked down and saw that it was still about twenty feet high. He grabbed the branch with one hand and quickly grabbed the strip of clothes with the other hand. He tied it to the branch with difficulty and finally breathed.
He moved his body carefully, and after a long time, he finally approached the cliff wall again and continued to climb down. When he was a few feet away from the bottom of the cliff, his clothes had been used to the limit, and Wang Lin quickly jumped down without thinking.
The clothes strip couldn't bear the weight and broke again, but it also slightly slowed Wang Lin's fall. The strong wind hit his face, and a series of branches broke. At the moment of landing, he struggled to control his body, toes first touched the ground, and his body rolled into a ball on the ground with the huge thrust of forward motion.
The stones on the ground were like sharp knives, piercing into his body one after another, leaving bloody wounds. Especially his right leg was stabbed by a sharp stone, and bones could be seen from the wound.
Wang Lin's breathing was rapid and his eyes were blurry. He took the cloth wrapped with stone beads from his neck into his mouth with difficulty, sucking the moist dew on it with his tongue. After a while, he struggled to sit up, untied the cloth with trembling hands, and twisted the wound on his right leg hard, and several drops of liquid fell.
A chill came from the wound. After doing all this, he fell weakly to the ground, secretly praying that no wild beast would come before he recovered.
At this moment, a shout suddenly came from a distance.
"Tie Zhu, where are you?"
Wang Lin was startled, and when he listened carefully, he realized that it was his father's voice. Before he could think about it, he immediately shouted with all his strength: "Dad, I'm here!"
A long rainbow quickly slid from a distance, wandered around the cliff above Wang Lin, and then fell down at lightning speed. After the sword light dissipated, the disciple named Zhang from Heng Yue sent his father with an iron pillar under his arm and frowned at Wang Lin.
When Tie Zhu's father saw his son, he immediately burst into tears. He ran to Wang Lin and hugged him, crying: "Tie Zhu, why are you doing this? Why can't you think about it? Have you ever thought about how your parents will live if you die?"
Wang Lin was startled, and after thinking about it for a moment, he realized that his father had misunderstood that he wanted to commit suicide. Looking at the wounds on his body and his embarrassed appearance, he couldn't help but smile bitterly.
The disciple surnamed Zhang glanced at Wang Lin, looked up and found strips of cloth. He jumped up and climbed to the cave in a few ups and downs. At this time, suction suddenly appeared. His face was shocked, but he immediately returned to normal and was not there. Paying attention to the suction, he glanced inside and gently dropped it, saying in a low voice: "Your child wanted to commit suicide, but was sucked by the naturally formed eye of the wind, so he did not fall to death. Now that Wang Lin has been found, the matter will be decided by the elders when he returns to the sect."
After saying that, he rolled up his sleeves and grabbed WangLin, father and son, left here quickly and soon arrived at the foot of the Hengyue Sect Peak. They easily climbed to the top along the stone steps.
Returning to the old place, Wang Lin felt mixed. There were several people standing on the top of the mountain, all with disgust on their faces. The disciple surnamed Zhang quickly stepped forward and said a few words in the ear of one of them. The man frowned and said in a cold voice: "Since I have found him, please send him to the guest room to meet his mother."
In the guest room, Wang Lin's mother burst into tears when she saw her son, hugged him and sobbed and complained. Only after her parents' oral explanation did Wang Lin know the whole story.
After he ran away from home, his parents immediately returned to the Wang family to find his fourth uncle. The three of them were worried about his safety and found Wang Zhuo's father. Due to his fourth uncle's toughness, Wang Zhuo's father reluctantly contacted all relatives in the family and jointly petitioned the Hengyue Sect, pleading for help in the search.
It was also the first time for the Hengyue Sect to encounter this kind of thing, and they didn't want to pay attention to it, but Wang Lin left home because he was not taken in. If there was something wrong, although they didn't care about a mortal's life or death, if this matter was publicized and spread by all the surrounding villagers, I'm afraid not many parents would let their children be tested in the future. After careful consideration, they sent a few people to search nearby. Wang Lin's father was worried and followed him.
